study_note: Seed-55 single-training-seed exploratory one-million-decision Humanoid Walk phase-1 prior-writeback actor-medium cell; one seed does not support a confidence or significance claim. After each planned training action and its diagnostics, 10% of the adapted actor displacement is written into the outer actor; critic write-back is disabled. This is the only learning-axis change from the q5-pair2 reference: the distributional critic retains five heads, every actor and target reduction samples two distinct heads and takes their minimum, both critic targets remain reward-only, and automatic outer temperature tuning retains the normalized rho-weighted actor-depth mixture. At step zero and every 50,000 decisions, observational evaluation runs the 100-sample fixed-seed Q-versus-MC protocols and five seed-12345 paired real-environment episodes comparing deterministic outer control with deterministic execution after a fresh action-local inner SAC solve at every state. The primary real improvement signal is eval/paired_fresh_inner_minus_outer. Training diagnostics publish the pre-writeback train/inner_final_outer_policy_kl every 1,000 decisions; no KL regularization loss is enabled. Evaluation disables write-back, adds only separately timed probe compute, and does not consume the training decision budget.
